attributes.body_ja:
「およそ」または「おおよそ」は「大体（だいたい）」や「ほぼ」という意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）す副詞（ふくし）です。漢字（かんじ）で「凡（およ）そ」や「大凡（おおよそ）」と書（か）かれることもあります。この表現（ひょうげん）はややフォーマルな場面（ばめん）で使（つか）われることが多（おお）く、アナウンスなどでよく耳（みみ）にします。

「おおよそ」は特（とく）に時間（じかん）や距離（きょり）に関（かん）して使（つか）われることが多（おお）く、ふつうは文（ぶん）の最初（さいしょ）に置（お）かれます。

豆知識（まめちしき）

漢字（かんじ）の「凡」そのものには「全体（ぜんたい）」や「ふつう」のような意味（いみ）があります。これは「(A) はほとんどの場合（ばあい）そうだが、１００（ひゃく）パーセントそうであるわけではない」ことを示（しめ）しています。
attributes.body:
およそ or おおよそ, alternatively written as either 凡（およ）そ or 大凡（おおよそ） is an adverb that commonly translates as 'approximately' or 'roughly' in English. It is primarily used in slightly more formal contexts, and can frequently be heard over announcements.

As おおよそ is an adverb that is used in relation to time or distance more than anything else, it will usually be positioned at the beginning of sentences.

Fun-fact

The kanji 凡 itself has the meaning of 'commonplace' and may also be translated as 'as a rule'. This just indicates that (A) is something that largely applies, but is not the case 100% of the time.

These can be used interchangeably to express roughly or about. だいたい is more casual and common in daily speech, as in だいたい百人来た (About a hundred people came). おおよそ sounds slightly more formal or written, as in おおよそ見当がつく (I can roughly guess). Note that だいたい can also appear as a negative interjection, as in だいたい何でいるの？ (Why are you here in the first place?), while おおよそ cannot be used this way.3

second_relatable.title: だいたい
second_relatable.meaning: Most・mostly, Adequately・generally, For the most part, Roughly・approximately, In the first place

attributes.body: Both can mean 'most', as in だいたいの人／おおよその人 'most people'. They can also both mean 'approximately', e.g. だいたい３時間／おおよそ３時間 'about three hours'. However, おおよそ is much more formal and mainly used in writing. だいたい can also express 'in the first place', e.g. だいたいなんでいるの？ ('Why are you here in the first place?)' or 'roughly/adequately', e.g. だいたいでいいから ('Roughly is fine.), while おおよそ cannot.
